results.name: Finite-record separation theorem
results.statement: For fixed finite-dimensional defect space W, linear scalar records detect every nonzero defect iff their restriction to W is injective; at least dim(W) independent scalar outputs are required.

results.name: Subcomplete-record universal certification
results.statement: Fewer than dim(W) scalar linear records cannot universally certify absence of defects on W; a nonzero kernel direction remains.

results.name: Octonion record bound
results.statement: Under the repository Cayley-Dickson convention, 512 basis associators span the full seven-dimensional imaginary octonion sector; scalar rank is zero, so seven independent scalar records are necessary and sufficient for full linear separation of this sector.

results.name: Resource revelation conservation
results.statement: For fixed W and refinement by adding linear records, rev_R+hid_R=dim(W), rev is nondecreasing, hid nonincreasing, and Delta rev=-Delta hid.

results.name: Unqualified hidden-defect monotonicity when W changes
results.statement: If the admissible defect space expands with refinement, hidden dimension may increase; a compatibility condition on W_R is necessary.

results.name: PDT-native physical record law / same-input departure from QM
results.statement: PDT still must derive the physically available record family and a same-input quantitative prediction rather than postulate informational completeness.
